snippet.title: Tulip Season - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the announcement trailer for Tulip Season, a farming sim developed by Poppy Labs. Plant, water, and nurture flowers as daily surprises hit the field. Sell bouquets, unlock new varieties, and get to know your customers. Maximize your field beauty to earn the king’s praise! Tulip Season is coming soon to PC (Steam).
